test_cases.description: A verbose customer initiates a detailed quote request for several catalog items, providing extra context and explanations. The request is sent from the primary contact email, establishing the business context for a later cross-contact approval.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: Multiple Items for Upcoming Project
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out to request a quote for several items that we are considering for an upcoming project at Lyn Ventures. We are in the early planning stages and would like to get pricing and availability information before finalizing our selections. Please see the list below:

1. T-Shirt (Item No: AITEM-0025) – We are looking at this as a potential uniform option for our staff. Please quote for 50 units.
2. Rug (Item No: AITEM-0030) – This will be used in our reception area. Please provide pricing for 3 units.
3. WonderWagon Pull-Along Train (Item No: AITEM-0001) – We are considering this for our children’s play zone. Please quote for 2 units.

If you need any additional information regarding our requirements or delivery timelines, please let me know. We are aiming to make a decision within the next week, so a prompt response would be appreciated.

Best regards,
Jim Schrute

test_cases.name: Initial Quote Request with Detailed Context from Toytopia
test_cases.description: Toytopia sends a detailed and polite email requesting a quote for several items, providing extra context and explanations. This is the initial turn in a scenario where the quote will later be approved from a different contact email, requiring the system to associate both turns with the same customer.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote on Toys and Accessories for Upcoming Promotion
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Alex, and I am reaching out on behalf of Toytopia as we are preparing for our upcoming spring promotion. We are looking to refresh our inventory with some of your products that have been popular with our customers in the past, as well as a few new items that caught our attention in your latest catalog.

Could you please provide a quote for the following items?

- 10 units of the WonderWagon Pull-Along Train. We have had great feedback on this item previously, and would like to restock in time for the new season.
- 15 units of the SmartToys Building Blocks. Our educational toy section is expanding, and these seem like a good fit.
- 12 units of the T-Shirt. We noticed there are a few T-Shirt options listed, but it is not clear which one is the best for children ages 5-8. Could you please quote for the T-Shirt that is most suitable for that age group?
- 8 units of the MagicToyland Fairy Doll. We have not stocked this item before, but it looks like it would appeal to our younger customers.

If you need any additional information from our side to prepare the quote, please let me know. We are aiming to finalize our order within the next week, so a timely response would be greatly appreciated.

Best regards,
Toytopia

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for Toys, Pizza, and Soda
initial_turn.body:
Hey there,

I hope you’re having a good day! I’m reaching out from German Bakery (Jakob Kuhs here) because we’re planning a little event for our staff and their families next month, and I wanted to get a quote for a few things. We’re thinking of having some fun activities for the kids, so I’d like to include some toys, plus pizza and drinks for everyone. Here’s what I have in mind:

- 2 sets of SmartToys Building Blocks (we want something that’s good for a range of ages, so if you have any advice on which version is best, let me know!)
- 4 pizzas (I see you have Pizza listed, but I’m not sure if there are different types or sizes—can you clarify what’s available?)
- 10 bottles of Soda – could you quote for both Large and Medium sizes, or let me know which is more popular for events?

If you need any more info from me, just ask! Looking forward to hearing back with the quote and any suggestions you might have. Thanks a lot!

Best,
Jakob Kuhs

Best regards,
Jakob Kuhs
